verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail offers some automatic behavior on incoming mail: AI-driven automatic labels and categorization, and junk filtering. It also offers APIs to connect the mailbox to other tools, so event-driven automation could be built externally. However, nothing in the evidence shows a user-facing rules engine where you define conditions that trigger actions. Missing for 10: user-defined rule/condition configuration, documented event triggers (e.g., on mail arrival), configurable actions such as auto-forward, scan, shred or deposit by rule, webhook/event documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
